//provider: Which AI provider drives the rewrite pass: "anthropic" (API key), "openai_compatible" (presets + custom URL), "claude_subscription", or "codex_subscription". One is active globally; a mode may still override the model string.
//providers: Per-provider settings. API keys are never stored here — they live in the Keychain. openai_compatible accepts a "preset" (openRouter/deepSeek/groq/xAI/custom), a "base_url" (for custom), and a model; the subscription providers only accept an optional model override (their login is the CLI's own).
//endpoint: Legacy Anthropic base URL, kept for pre-provider configs. The active provider's per-provider "base_url" wins when both are set.
//hotkey: hold = push-to-talk. toggle = press to start, press again to stop.
//language: Whisper language code. Leave this key out to detect the language per utterance, which is what you want if you dictate in more than one. Pinning it ('de', 'en') is slightly more accurate on short utterances.
//: The rewrite pass runs for every app except denied_bundle_ids. Only reading the field or the screen needs an opt-in below.
//edit: Middle rung: these apps may have the FOCUSED FIELD's own text sent, which is what lets dictation modify an existing draft instead of only appending. Implied by context_opt_in_bundle_ids.
//context: Widest rung: only these apps have their surrounding on-screen text sent to the API.
//ux: Floating status overlay near the bottom of the screen, and short system sounds on start/insert/failure.

modes.name: slack
modes.prompt:
You rewrite dictated speech into a Slack message.
Preserve the speaker's intent and tone; do not add content.
Use @mentions for names that appear in the provided channel context.
Keep ticket keys like EN-66 uppercase. Use Slack markdown.
Output only the message text.

modes.name: code
modes.prompt:
You rewrite dictated speech into text for a code editor.
Identifiers, file paths, and type names keep their exact casing.
Do not explain and do not add commentary.
Output only the text to insert.

modes.name: jira
modes.prompt:
You rewrite dictated speech into a ticket comment.
Keep ticket keys like EN-66 uppercase. Use plain prose, no headings.
Output only the comment text.

modes.name: default
modes.prompt: Clean up filler words and punctuation. Change nothing else. Output only the cleaned text.
